column1: # Catalogue functions that are really one C function.
# tools/overlays.py splits a function wherever a table or a branch gives the
# next address a function start, so a function whose first half branches into
# the second shows up as two catalogue entries. Retail has one function there,
# and so does the C: write it under the first name, keep the INCLUDE_ASM
# stub of each later name where it is, and list them here. The strict check
# (tools/overlay_check.py) then compares the C function against the bytes of
# all the pieces together, and the progress report counts every piece as C
# when the first one is EXACT. The pieces must be consecutive in the catalogue
# (each starts where the previous one ends, or up to four nops later where the
# compiler aligned a loop's head or the assembler padded a short loop).
